newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telepizza to put profits into reserves, no dividend.
newsitem.headline: Telepizza to put profits into reserves, no dividend.

text.p: Spain's pizza delivery firm Telepizza said on Friday it would put its 1996 profits into reserves and would not pay a dividend.

"Telepizza will propose at the next shareholders meeting to transfer the company's profits to reserves, with the result that it will not distribute a dividend," Spain's stock market commission said in a statement.
The company said it wanted to increase reserves to make more funds available for investments.
"The board of directors had in mind the investment needed to purchase Pizza World as well as opening new shops in 1997 when it made this proposal," the CNMV said.
The acquisition of Pizza World would involve a payment of not more than 1.9 billion pesetas, the CNMV said.
The transfer will be put to shareholders at the next meeting.
Telepizza reported a 66 percent increase in group profits for 1996 of 1.70 billion pesetas.
